data.name: Resident Evil 0
data.detailed_description:
Be prepared to relive the first nightmare in Resident Evil 0, a remastered version of the popular prequel to the original Resident Evil game. This remastered version takes the fear-inducing atmosphere from the original 2002 release and transforms it with stunning new HD visuals, improved sound, widescreen support and an optional modernized control system and more. It’s the best way to experience the story of what really happened before the iconic mansion incident that was the catalyst for the entire Resident Evil saga.

The story of Resident Evil 0 takes players back to 1998. Reports have been mounting about unusual murders on the outskirts of Raccoon City. The city’s Special Forces division, S.T.A.R.S., sends their Bravo Team - including rookie cop member Rebecca Chambers - to investigate. On route, the team’s helicopter suffers engine trouble and is forced to make a crash landing, where they find an overturned prisoner transport vehicle. Splitting up to search the area, Rebecca discovers the Ecliptic Express, a train stopped dead on the tracks. Inside, she meets death row convict and ex-Navy lieutenant Billy Coen. Throughout the game, you will take control of both Rebecca and Billy, at times switching between both characters in order to proceed. Learning the advantages of each character is the key to solving puzzles and surviving the nightmares that lie ahead.

Features

  • Return to the series origins – Discover the truth behind what led to the horrors at the Mansion in Resident Evil in this fan-favorite and popular prequel title to the series.
  • Completely enhanced visuals – New high-resolution textures have been created from scratch, including 1080p support on next-gen consoles, while still preserving the classic appearance of the original release.
  • Fully remastered sound effects – 5.1 surround support provides a more experiential gaming atmosphere that best matches players’ listening environments.
  • Experience the horror in the classic 4:3 ratio or newly added 16:9 widescreen mode.
  • Play with the classic control scheme, or enjoy a new alternative scheme where the character moves in the direction of an analogue stick.
  • Fan-favorite Resident Evil characters – Rookie S.T.A.R.S. member Rebecca Chambers and wanted criminal Billy Coen combine skills and buddy up to survive the undead and infected nightmares that await them.
  • Wesker Mode - After completing the main storyline, you will be able to take control of series antagonist Albert Wesker, and use his superhuman abilities to power through the missions.

reviews.review:
I have basically played every single RE game that is on steam and i have not given any of them a negative review, but this is an exception. Every single so called puzzle is made to waste your time and to ruin your experience as much as possible. This was also my first game that uses such unique camera angles and it almost ruined it for me.

Pros
Warm colors, well made cut-scenes, great voice acting, mid story, guns feel nice and the fact that it is RE.


Cons:
Horrible level design, hideous and frustrating backtracking that you have to do every single moment. Small and tight environment, where you basically have no wear to hide or escape from the zombies. 

Disgusting inventory system, where you can barely even fit anything in your inventory, honestly, if i was not able to stack 200 bullets in one bar of my inventory, i would have given up. You have to drop this to get that, then get this to get that and it gets to the point where it is exhausting. 

Speaking of exhausting, i get it, it is an old game, but oh my days... going from one door to another or moving from lower level to upper feels like a chore, because you have to go through a cut-scene. From the beginning it feels unique and refreshing, but once you experience it 50 times, it gets super boring. Especially, if you left something behind or you accidentally picked up something that you did not have to or any kind of similar scenario, you have to go through those "cut-scenes" several times. Frankly, if the game is 15 hrs long out of that 15 hrs 1 is dedicated to just going through doors.

Game does not indicate to anything at all, besides the items that are already visible to you. I was literally watching a video as i was going through these levels, first i finished the game with that video and then i finished it with my own gameplay. Just because i had no clue to what had to be done, i have spent at least 5 hours out of my 15 just wandering around. Not to mention, how many times i had to go back for some item that i had dropped, because i did not think i would need it or because of some medical mixtures that Rebeca had to have, but i had no idea those things even existed. Its not like "oh, i have cleared the path, so no problem if i waste time and go back" oh, no... Even if you cleared the road, there are going to be monkeys or some other animals there, which do not miss and are extremely fast, so you either kill them or you just die.

This leads me to another point, i played on normal and its way too damn difficult. There are no bullets, no heals, no nothing. I was watching the guy who played on easy and when he had 3 fully healable herbs and 300 pistol bullets, i had 0 herbs and both of my characters were running on danger mode with 5 pistol bullets. Now, imagine me being like that having to figure out that i left some medical mixture 5 miles away and i have to go back and through those monkeys. It felt really nice, i gotta tell you. 

People like to boost their egos saying "oh, the game is for smart people, you would not get it", the game is garbage in that sense, i feel so bad for those poor souls that had to play this without the internet. Please tell me, how is the game for "smart people" when the game literally does not tell you what to do or where to go? Listen, i can also solve a simple puzzle IF I KNOW WHERE IT IS. 

It almost feels like that Capcom was out of ideas and decided to add random animal zombies for no reason. Also, its already difficult enough to dodge or move with such camera angles that are in the game and to add to that, you can not dodge most zombies or animals, especially frogs, monkeys and that jelly green man that sometimes appears. it is impossible, unless you spam bullets. Also, they spawn on such random places, you do not even have time to react. 

I also do not like that idea that there are no out-saves. Again, i get it, Out-saves are something new and they babysit you, but man... if you forget to save or the level goes on for a while and you die out of sudden, you have to start everything all over again. 

Anyway, if you are a hardcore RE fan, sure play it, but if you are just getting into it, then i would recommend just watching a video of someone to get the story of it, so you can save your nerves.
